channel.title: SetsOfLove blog
channel.description: Practical, friendly guides for single gym-goers: meeting people respectfully, building a profile, dating around training and staying safe.

item.title: How to take a good mirror selfie for your profile
item.description: Mirror selfie tips for a gym profile: wipe the glass, hold your phone at chest height, check the background and keep bystanders out of frame.

item.title: Is it okay to ask someone out at the gym?
item.description: Is it okay to ask someone out at the gym? Sometimes, with conditions. Here's how to do it kindly, take a no well and use lower-pressure routes.

item.title: Dates, a relationship, marriage or friendship: know what you're after
item.description: What are you looking for in a relationship? A plain way to work out what you want now, say it in one sentence and respect other people's answers.

item.title: Online dating safety tips for Australians
item.description: Online dating safety tips for Australians: keep a slow pace, video call first, meet in public, tell a friend and never send money.

item.title: Dating when you train at 5 am
item.description: Dating when you train early means protecting your sleep without going rigid. Here's how to plan evenings, morning dates and honest schedules.

item.title: The big four lifts explained for beginners
item.description: The bench press, squat, deadlift and overhead press explained for beginners: what each lift trains, why they're popular and how to start safely.

item.title: How to talk to someone at the gym without being awkward
item.description: How to talk to someone at the gym without being awkward: pick your moment, keep it short, offer an easy exit and accept a quiet reply.

item.title: What is SetsOfLove? A profile app for single gym-goers
item.description: SetsOfLove is a gym dating profile app: one page at your own link, 1 to 4 photos, optional lifts, no messages, and every profile approved first.
